desc: API name mistral-medium-2508. Marked deprecated in Mistral docs with replacement date May 22, 2026 (Medium 3.5 recommended), though still served via OpenRouter as of 2026-07-31. ECI candidate 'Mistral Medium 3' is the earlier 25.05 version, so no match.

name: Mistral Small 4
desc: Announced 2026-03-16 (https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-small-4/): sparse MoE unifying Magistral (reasoning), Pixtral (vision), and Devstral (coding) with configurable reasoning effort; docs card describes it as 'a powerful hybrid model unifying instruct, reasoning, and coding'. Auto fuzzy ECI suggestion 'Mistral Small 3.1' rejected (different generation).

name: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B A3B Reasoning (free)
desc: Omni-modal (text, image, video up to 2 min, audio up to 1 hr in; text out) hybrid MoE Transformer-Mamba with Conv3D video layers and Efficient Video Sampling. Reasoning enabled by default, toggleable via enable_thinking. Training data spans 2019-2025 with no explicit knowledge cutoff stated. Free-only endpoint on OpenRouter (256K context).

name: gpt-oss-20b
desc: Model card gives 20.9B total / 3.61B active (HF card rounds to 21B/3.6B). 131,072-token context; full raw CoT. ECI lists only gpt-oss-120b, so no match for the 20b.

name: o1-pro
desc: API version of o1 pro mode (more compute per query), released in the API 2025-03-19 as snapshot o1-pro-2025-03-19 (default snapshot per OpenAI docs). Responses-API-only, no streaming; $150/M input, $600/M output. Overrode auto fuzzy ECI suggestion 'o1': o1-pro is a distinct higher-compute tier and the ECI candidate list has no o1-pro entry (it has o3-pro, which is a different generation), so null.

name: Step 3.5 Flash
desc: StepFun's agent-first open MoE (196.81B total incl. 0.81B MTP head, ~11B active, 288 routed + 1 shared expert, top-8; MTP-3 gives 100-300+ tok/s). Frontier-reasoning benchmarks (AIME 2025 97.3, SWE-bench Verified 74.4) imply thinking-by-default; classified 'reasoning' (effort levels exist in the Step 3.x line; an explicit off switch is not documented - flagged). auto_eci_fuzzy 'Gemini 3.5 Flash' rejected: different developer entirely.

name: GLM 4.5
desc: Hybrid: explicit thinking mode (reasoning/tools) and non-thinking mode. OR listing (2025-07-25) predates the official 2025-07-28 announcement by three days. No GLM-4.5 entry in ECI candidates.

name: GLM 4.5 Air
desc: Compact sibling launched alongside GLM-4.5 (same 2025-07-28 announcement); BF16 and FP8 checkpoints published.

name: GLM 4.6V
desc: 106B MoE VLM (GLM-V family) with 128K context, native visual function calling, image + video input (OR endpoint: image+text+video, hence omni). Hybrid classification inferred from the GLM-V family thinking-mode switch and OR reasoning support; the HF card fetch did not explicitly confirm the toggle - flagged. Lightweight sibling GLM-4.6V-Flash (9B) is a separate model, not this endpoint.

name: GLM 4.7 Flash
desc: Lightweight 30B-A3B MoE sibling of GLM-4.7 with Preserved-Thinking mode; free tier on Z.ai API. Fuzzy ECI suggestion 'GLM-4.7' rejected - that entry is the 355B flagship, not this 30B Flash model.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct
desc: Coding-specialized fine-tune line within Qwen2.5. The 32B weights shipped 2024-11-12 with the 'Qwen2.5-Coder Family' post; the ECI entry is dated 2024-09-18 (the Qwen2.5-Coder tech-report/series announcement) but names the same 32B model. Native context 131,072 (YaRN); OpenRouter endpoint serves 32,768.

name: Qwen3 14B
desc: Hybrid thinking/non-thinking via enable_thinking and /think //no_think soft switches; open-weight model emits raw <think> traces which OpenRouter returns as text reasoning. Auto fuzzy 'Qwen-14B' rejected: that ECI entry is the original Qwen (v1) 14B from 2023. Native context 32,768; 131,072 via YaRN (what the endpoint lists).

name: Qwen3 30B A3B
desc: ECI candidate 'Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B' is a different, later generation (Qwen3.6, 2026) — not this model. Native context 32,768; 131,072 via YaRN.

name: Qwen3 30B A3B Instruct 2507
desc: Non-thinking-only July 2025 refresh of the small Qwen3 MoE (30.5B total / 3.3B active, 128 experts, 8 active). No ECI candidate for this size.

name: Qwen3 30B A3B Thinking 2507
desc: Thinking-only variant (QwenLM GitHub lists July 31, Simon Willison covered it July 30; day-level ambiguity only). OpenRouter listed it later (2025-08-28). Open reasoning model; raw CoT returned.

name: Qwen3 32B
desc: Largest dense Qwen3. No matching ECI candidate. Native context 32,768; 131,072 via YaRN.

name: Qwen3 8B
desc: Auto fuzzy 'Qwen-1_8B' rejected: that is the original Qwen (v1) 1.8B, unrelated. Native context 32,768; 131,072 via YaRN.

name: Qwen3 Coder 30B A3B Instruct
desc: Officially nicknamed 'Qwen3-Coder-Flash' in the July 31, 2025 announcement, but this OpenRouter entry serves the open Hugging Face weights; the separate OR slug qwen/qwen3-coder-flash serves Alibaba's hosted commercial endpoint. Native 256K context (1M with YaRN).

name: Qwen3 Next 80B A3B Instruct
desc: Hybrid-attention architecture preview (Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention, 512 experts / 10 active, multi-token prediction). HF card: instruct (non-thinking) mode only. 262K native context.

name: Qwen3 VL 235B A22B Instruct
desc: Flagship open VL model. Modality conflict: official card/repo supports image AND video input, but the OpenRouter endpoint lists text+image only, so classified vision-language (not omni) per the API-served modalities. Overrode auto fuzzy 'Qwen3-235B-A22B' (that ECI entry is the text-only LLM, not the VL model).

name: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Instruct
desc: Small VL MoE (30.5B total / ~3.3B active, same MoE base as Qwen3-30B-A3B); official announcement tweet 2025-10-04, QwenLM GitHub timeline lists October 4, 2025. Official model supports video input; OR endpoint lists text+image only.

name: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Thinking
desc: Thinking edition released with the Instruct on 2025-10-04. Open reasoning VL model; raw CoT returned. Official video input; OR endpoint text+image only.

name: Qwen3 VL 32B Instruct
desc: Dense 32B VL model released 2025-10-21 alongside the 2B (QwenLM GitHub timeline). Official video input; OR endpoint lists text+image only. | AA also maps the sibling Thinking variant to this OR id; AA columns here use the Instruct (non-reasoning) config.

name: Qwen3 VL 8B Instruct
desc: Dense 8B VL model, released with the 4B on 2025-10-15 per the QwenLM GitHub timeline (OR listed 2025-10-14; day-level timezone difference). Official video input; OR endpoint lists image+text only.

name: Qwen3 VL 8B Thinking
desc: Thinking edition of the dense 8B VL model (released 2025-10-15 per QwenLM GitHub). Open reasoning VL model; raw CoT returned. Official video input; OR endpoint image+text only.

name: Olmo 3 32B Think
desc: Fully open 'model flow' release from Ai2 (data, checkpoints, training code all open). Produces raw <think> chain-of-thought by default. HF card states date cutoff Dec. 2024.

name: Command A
desc: 256K context (HF config ships 128K by default; OpenRouter serves 256K). Cohere's later 'Command A Reasoning' is a separate model, not this endpoint.

name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 70B
desc: SFT distillation of R1 reasoning (800K samples) onto Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct; MIT-released but base remains subject to the Llama 3.3 Community License. Released with R1 on 2025-01-20 (OR listed 2025-01-23). Endpoint quirk: OR context is only 8,192 tokens, far below the model's native 131K. Not matched to any ECI entry (no distill entries in candidates; do not match to full R1).

name: Gemma 3 12B
desc: Instruction-tuned variant. Official 128K context matches OpenRouter 131072. auto_eci_fuzzy suggested 'Gemma 3 27B' - rejected, different size; ECI has no 12B entry.

name: Gemma 3 4B
desc: Instruction-tuned variant; smallest multimodal Gemma 3 size (1B/270M are text-only). Official 128K context matches OpenRouter 131072. auto_eci_fuzzy suggested 'Gemma 3 27B' - rejected, different size.

name: Granite 4.1 8B
desc: Dense decoder-only model from the Granite 4.1 refresh (3B/8B/30B, all non-reasoning, Apache 2.0). IBM claims the 8B matches the prior 32B MoE flagship Granite 4.0-H-Small on many benchmarks. 131K context.

name: Ling-2.6-flash
desc: Small non-thinking instruct MoE (104B total / 7.4B active, 1:7 MLA + Lightning linear-attention hybrid). OpenRouter listed 2026-04-21, i.e. API availability preceded the 2026-04-28 open-weights release on HF - hence release_date flag. int4 and base variants also published by inclusionAI.

name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
desc: Lightweight on-device text model announced at Meta Connect 2024. Model natively supports 128K context but the current OpenRouter endpoint caps at 60,000 tokens (provider-specific). Auto-fuzzy ECI suggestion 'Llama 3.2 90B' rejected (wrong size/variant; ECI has no 1B entry).

name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
desc: Lightweight on-device text model announced at Meta Connect 2024, 128K context. Auto-fuzzy ECI suggestion 'Llama 3.2 90B' rejected (wrong size/variant; ECI has no 3B entry).

name: Ministral 3 14B
desc: Mistral 3 family (Dec 2, 2025). Base, instruct, and reasoning variants were released; this OpenRouter endpoint serves the instruct (non-thinking) variant (no reasoning parameter support). Native image understanding at all Ministral 3 sizes.

name: Ministral 3 3B
desc: Mistral 3 family (Dec 2, 2025). Instruct (non-thinking) variant served on OpenRouter; reasoning variants exist separately. 131k context on this endpoint vs 262k for the 8B/14B siblings.

name: Ministral 3 8B
desc: Mistral 3 family (Dec 2, 2025). Instruct (non-thinking) variant served on OpenRouter; reasoning variants exist separately.

name: Mistral Small 3
desc: Latency-optimized 24B (mistral-small-2501). Auto fuzzy ECI suggestion 'Mistral Medium 3' rejected; ECI has no Mistral Small 3 entry (Small 3.1 is a different, later model).

name: Mistral Small 3.2
desc: Minor update over 3.1 (instruction following, fewer infinite generations, more robust function calling). No standalone announcement post found; HF repo id '2506' confirms June 2025 and the day (20) is taken from the OpenRouter listing date.

name: GLM 4.5V
desc: VLM built on GLM-4.5-Air-Base with a Thinking Mode switch. Modality conflict: official HF card also documents video input, but the OR endpoint accepts text+image only - classified vision-language per the endpoint. OR context is 65,536 (below the model's native window).
